Class JmtEdge

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode
org.jgraph.graph.DefaultGraphCell
org.jgraph.graph.DefaultEdge
jsimgraph.JGraphMod.JmtEdge
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, MutableTreeNode, TreeNode, org.jgraph.graph.Edge, org.jgraph.graph.GraphCell
public class JmtEdge extends org.jgraph.graph.DefaultEdge

Title: JmtEdge connection structure

Description: This class is used to connect two elements into JmtGraph. It is designed to store keys of source and target stations that are used when deleting or copying a connection

Author:
Bertoli Marco Date: 17-giu-2005 Time: 19.25.45, Giuseppe De Cicco & Fabio Granara Date: 23-sett-2006
